name: Saddy Nkurunziza
about:
I was born in Rwanda and live in Kigali.

I'm currently studying and freelancing. Right now, my main focus is [Rugero](/rugero) an all-in-one system for small businesses to manage inventory, sales, and accounting.

Earlier, I built [Ibuka](/ibuka), an interactive digital history project that brought in 21,000 visitors at launch.

On the side, I build and maintain lightweight open source libraries, including [inklu](/inklu), [Jace](/jace), and [settle](/settle).
